items.q: Does DineDesk take a commission on my orders?
items.a: No. You pay a monthly plan. Online payments go to your own Razorpay account (Razorpay's own fees apply), and cash and counter payments are yours.

items.q: Do I need a developer or designer?
items.a: No. You pick a theme, add your logo, photos and menu, and go live from the dashboard. Everything can be changed later.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes, on Growth and Pro. Your site also keeps a free address on the DineDesk domain.

items.q: Will my website show up on Google?
items.a: Every live site gets page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and business details in the format search engines read. Ranking depends on your content and reviews, so add real photos and keep your hours up to date.
Yes. The Pro plan adds rooms, an online booking engine, front desk, housekeeping and room-service ordering from a QR code in each room.
